summary.intent: Work through the NEXT-WORK plan for the Callisto release tool (cleanup, test debt, SYS-RETRY, SYS-NAPI, refactors), then optimize performance for large monorepos, draft ADR 13 for tag-annotation hints, and start adopting michi 0.6.
summary.outcome: Opened and merged many PRs: #202-#208 (retry fix, tests, docs refresh, init/derive refactors, napi roster), the perf stack #327/#328/#330/#333 (merged), ADR 13 as PR #335 (Proposed), and a michi-graph 0.6 bump PR. The michi pipeline trial and ADR 13 implementation were started but not completed.

repo: docs/projects/NEXT-WORK.md is local tracking only; it now lives at .claude/plans/NEXT-WORK.md, excluded via .git/info/exclude. Tracking and handoff plans must never go in a commit or PR.
`just ci` is the gate (90% coverage threshold); it is run through wrapper scripts and the log's own `exit=` line must be read, not the task-notification exit code.
AGENTS.md forbids session links in commits/PRs; ADRs need user acceptance and stay Proposed until the implementing PR merges.
Stacked PRs are linked with `gh stack`; a closed PR in a stack blocks relinking, so unstack and recreate the stack.
Release harness fakes (gh, cargo, registry) can hide bugs; tests should use the real tool where possible (e.g. real jq and real binary for the napi roster test).
Callisto uses system git via crates/callisto-model/src/vcs/access.rs; ADR 5 chose the git binary. Measurements showed gix is 3-10x slower than git log for history at scale, so gix was rejected.
Changed-since-tag now compares git tree ids per package directory (net change), so reverted edits no longer count; status is flat in commit count.
IdentityIndex native_names/native_name/platforms_of were quadratic; fixed with a reverse index. Locator and manifest pre-open now run in parallel (parallel.rs).
The tag-ownership manifest read is a safety check against renamed/removed packages and should not be skipped on name uniqueness; the proposed fix is tag annotation hints (ADR 13).
macOS bash lacks mapfile, so generated workflow scripts must use portable loops.
Local ~/Projects/michi checkout was behind published 0.6 (no poll.rs/blocking.rs); michi 0.6 crates are on crates.io, npm package held until 2026-10-24 02:55 UTC.

code.finding: Callisto's git access uses the system binary here; there is no gix cache to tune in production code.
Large derive function was split into stage functions after characterization snapshots; uploads_by_package moved into OpIndex.
Contains settle_issued, whose confirmation window restarts after each confirmation and counts only sleeps; slated to be replaced by michi poll_step/deadline_group.

friction: Mistakenly put the local-only plan file in PR #201; user objected and it was closed.
Sandbox blocked inline env commands, heredocs and scripts mentioning git, forcing script-file workarounds.
Background sessions could not edit the shared checkout's .claude/plans file to record PR status.
First gix spike created a diff resource cache but never used it, leading to an unfair comparison and later retractions.
User was annoyed when the assistant fetched michi 0.6 into a scratch crate rather than reading the local checkout, which turned out to be stale.
Release PR #316 became stale after the perf stack merged and needs regeneration.
Closed PR in a stack blocked gh stack relink.
open_items: Delete leftover branch docs/next-work-plan and ~35 stale local branches (needs per-branch user approval).
W1 real-service credential check needs a decision on where it runs in CI.
Regenerate release PR #316 and re-trigger CI before merging to ship 0.14.0.
Fix settle_issued window bugs via michi 0.6 poll_step/deadline_group/precheck trial (own PR stacked after #316).
Adopt michi-graph ready_by_edge once PR #48 releases; consider OIDC instead of the deprecated NPM_TOKEN.
ADR 13 (PR #335) awaits acceptance; implementation tasks for writing and reading tag hints are pending.
#204 still lists SYS-RETRY/T08-RETRY and needs a follow-up edit after #202 merges; independent review findings on #202 were being addressed.
Remaining lanes: D SYS-BARRIER, F R1 walk.rs::build, W9, W10, W11 and decisions on D01, RewriteKey, and Python dev groups.
Optional upstream gix-pack issue about caching intermediate delta objects was offered but not requested.
